# qualys_vaults (Data Source)

Look up credential vaults configured for the subscription.

Referencing a vault from an authentication record keeps the secret out of
Terraform configuration and state entirely, which is preferable to supplying a
password.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "qualys_vaults" "all" {}

output "vault_titles" {
  value = [for v in data.qualys_vaults.all.vaults : v.title]
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- **id** (String) The ID of this resource.
- **title** (String) Return only the vault with this exact title.
